articles.title: स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण 2025-26 के परिणामों की घोषणा

summary: Results of Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 have been announced.

questions.question: Where was India's first LED dome planetarium, the 'Cosmos-Mysuru Planetarium', inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated India's first LED dome planetarium, the 'Cosmos-Mysuru Planetarium', in Mysuru, Karnataka.

Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

questions.explanation: The Prime Minister expressed grief over the deaths caused by an accident in the Golaghat district of Assam.
